phases.name: Base
phases.goal: Go from 3 to 5 runs a week; long run stays 12-13 km; start hill sprints and gym.

phases.name: Build
phases.goal: Daniels' 2-week cycle: R or I on Thursday, M finish on every second long run.

phases.name: Race-specific
phases.goal: Half-marathon-pace work; long run peaks at 16 km on Jan 16.

phases.name: Taper & race
phases.goal: Distance down 20%, then 60%; short bits of T and HM pace keep you sharp.
